verdict.rationale: Luma's own homepage says its Agents "research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text," which suggests audio generation inside the same workspace. However, nothing documents sound effects, ambient audio, or music generation, or matching audio to the generated scene. The Ray model and API docs cover only video and image capabilities. Missing for 10: documented sound-effect, ambient or music generation; scene-matched or synchronized audio for generated video; API or workflow details for audio; independent or hands-on corroboration.
